title: C10: restrict model write permissions via acceptEdits + settings file
goal: Replace --dangerously-skip-permissions at both route.sh spawn sites with --permission-mode acceptEdits plus a jq-validated settings file that grants only the worktree and stage scratch dir, and amend ADR-018 to record the change.

steps.description: Create core/router/permissions.sh: exports _zbuild_build_permissions_settings (writes ${ZBUILD_STAGE_SCRATCH}/claude-settings.json with allowedDirectories = [ZBUILD_REPO_ROOT, ZBUILD_STAGE_SCRATCH], validates with jq, returns rc=1 on parse failure) and _zbuild_permission_args (emits --permission-mode acceptEdits --settings <file> --add-dir <worktree> --add-dir <scratch> tokens). Settings file is built before _zbuild_make_fresh_shell runs, mirroring the restate-before-scrub pattern at route.sh:368-372.

Wire permissions.sh into route.sh single-shot path (line ~807): source permissions.sh once near the top of route.sh's loader block, replace the `_claude_args+=(--dangerously-skip-permissions)` line with a call to `_zbuild_build_permissions_settings` (abort spawn on rc≠0 per SPEC-3) then `_claude_args+=($(_zbuild_permission_args))`. Satisfies SPEC-1 and SPEC-3.

Wire permissions.sh into route.sh agent-loop path (line ~1562): same replacement — call _zbuild_build_permissions_settings (abort iteration on failure) then append _zbuild_permission_args output. Satisfies SPEC-1 for the loop path. Verify `grep -rn 'skip-permissions' core/router/` is clean afterward (SPEC-4).

Write tests/unit/router-permissions-test.sh: covers SPEC-2 (settings file contains correct allowedDirectories for worktree + scratch), SPEC-3 (missing/unparseable settings file causes spawn refusal, not silent bypass), and SPEC-4 (grep core/router/ for skip-permissions returns nothing). Uses the same argv-recording mock pattern as router-claude-flags-test.sh.

Update tests/unit/router-claude-flags-test.sh lines 86 and 103: replace assert_contains for --dangerously-skip-permissions with assert_contains for --permission-mode and acceptEdits. Add assert_contains for --settings and --add-dir tokens. Preserve the existing order-insensitive token-set style (mirrors :73-77). Satisfies SPEC-1 unit coverage.

Update tests/integration/router-claude-flags-test.sh line 114: same replacement — remove --dangerously-skip-permissions assertion, add --permission-mode / acceptEdits / --settings / --add-dir assertions. Satisfies SPEC-1 integration coverage.

Amend docs/adr/ADR-018-stage-invocation-modes.md: add an **Amended:** block at the top of the document citing this issue number and the CLI version from the P0–P4 probe results; replace the claim at lines 25, 28-33, 40, 41, 68, 350, 462 that --dangerously-skip-permissions is required with the P0 result (acceptEdits keeps tools accessible headless). Record that Bash surface is not blocked by the permission mode (P3 finding) and is covered instead by C8/TMPDIR and #1809 sweep.

notes: P0–P4 probe results must be recorded in the issue before the build stage begins (hard prerequisite per issue body). The settings file path derives from ZBUILD_STAGE_SCRATCH (ADR-058 §1 env var) rather than any literal path, satisfying the ADR-059 layout-move requirement. If ZBUILD_STAGE_SCRATCH is unset at spawn time the implementation should fall back to zbuild_engine_tmpdir() (same pattern used at route.sh:1547) and emit a warning event. The redaction-chokepoint test at tests/unit/redaction-chokepoint-test.sh:47,66-70 constrains settings writes to remain inside core/router/ — permissions.sh satisfies that. stage-checkpoint-test.sh:259-271 greps for _claude_args array rewrite and turn-cap lines far from :807/:1562 and will still pass unchanged.
